# rintup_maintenance_window (Resource)

A maintenance window: alerts are muted for its monitors while it is active. One-off (default: starts now, lasts 60 minutes) or recurring (`daily`, `weekly`, `monthly` at `start_time` in `time_zone`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One-off window for a release.
resource "rintup_maintenance_window" "release" {
  name        = "Release 4.2"
  monitor_ids = [rintup_monitor.api.id]
  starts_at   = "2026-11-15T22:00:00Z"
  ends_at     = "2026-11-15T23:30:00Z"
}

# Every Sunday 03:00-04:00 Istanbul time, for all monitors (empty set).
resource "rintup_maintenance_window" "weekly_backup" {
  name             = "Weekly backup"
  monitor_ids      = []
  recurrence       = "weekly"
  days             = [0]
  start_time       = "03:00"
  duration_minutes = 60
  time_zone        = "Europe/Istanbul"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `monitor_ids` (Set of String) Monitors covered. An empty set means every monitor of the workspace.

### Optional

- `days` (Set of Number) Weekly: days 0-6 (0 = Sunday). Monthly: days of the month 1-31.
- `duration_minutes` (Number) Length of each window in minutes. Default: 60.
- `ends_at` (String) RFC 3339 time. One-off: end (default: starts_at + duration). Recurring: end of the series; leave unset for no end.
- `name` (String) Name. Default: `Maintenance`.
- `recurrence` (String) `none`, `daily`, `weekly` or `monthly`. Default: `none`.
- `start_time` (String) Recurring: local start time `HH:mm` (required for recurring windows).
- `starts_at` (String) RFC 3339 time. One-off: start (default: now). Recurring: the series is valid from this time.
- `time_zone` (String) IANA time zone of start_time. Default: the workspace time zone, else UTC.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) A window is running now.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `next_ends_at` (String) End of the running or next occurrence.
- `next_starts_at` (String) Start of the running or next occurrence.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import rintup_maintenance_window.weekly_backup 0192f3a4-5b6c-7d8e-9f00-112233445566
```
